answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 155300 Country: India Title: Dua for job Question: Asslamu Alekum Mufti -e - Ikram Shahab , My Name is Suhail Rashid, I am staying in Bangalore location I lose my job last 5 month . i am very worried, daily last 4 month alhumduliallah i m reading suree Waqia after magrib namaz. second thing when ever i go for interview always i did not clear any interview Can you please tell me any wazifa so that i can get a job also clear the interview Please pray for me i m very worried last 5 months. Regards, Suhail Rashid 9740719620 Answer ID: 155300 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 91/59/SN=2/1439) Read the following dua extensively: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ . Also read Surah Fatiha with Bismillah 41 times between the Fajr and Fajr sunnah daily with durood 11-11 times before and after. Also attend the interview with full preparation. In-shaAllah, you shall be successful and the door of provision shall open for you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
